task_description: Complete migration from Firebase (Auth, Firestore, Storage) to Supabase (Auth, Database) and Cloudinary (media storage). Replace all Firebase Auth with Supabase Auth, all Firestore reads/writes with Supabase table queries, and Firebase Storage with Cloudinary uploads. Remove all Firebase dependencies.
